correctness.rationale: Direct cycle word enumeration gives Lucas periodic counts and reflection fixed counts \(F_{\lfloor n/2floor+2}\); summing all finite-index dihedral subgroups yields the exact zeta. Factoring its rational denominator identifies two equimodular real poles. At the positive pole, explicit A, B, p and Cauchy–Gaussian saddle expansion give the coefficient formula; at the negative pole the smaller positive residue gives exponential suppression. The standalone checker separately enumerates finite combinatorics and coefficients but does not replace the infinite proof.

The sharp \(arphi^{n/2}\exp(2\sqrt{An})n^{-1/2}\) profile and evaluated prefactor display a nontrivial intermediate growth scale and resolve the equal-modulus negative singularity; this goes beyond a radius-of-convergence or prime-orbit estimate.
